scope: 32 bounded synthetic assignments, 16 roles, two configurations per role; implementation checked independently and review criteria assessed by the primary agent.
limitations: The category ordering is the selection policy; measured billing equivalence or lower actual token consumption was not established.
Native delegation selected the requested configurations; per-specialist file precedence and observed hooks in Desktop/VS Code remain separate acceptance checks.
Some native workers completed multiple independent role assignments in one thread, with separate inputs and outputs and no access to other model responses.
UI reviews were static, not browser/device execution. Required bundles were outside the restricted evaluation directories and were not loaded.
The desktop evaluator escape repair is recorded separately; its syntax error was not a model failure.
